svg.text: 100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province
1. Do not scale. Use figured dimensions only.
2. Site plan dims in metres; building dims in mm.
3. Levels in metres, relative to site datum
4. Boundary and road reserve assumed from
aerial imagery. Confirm by cadastral survey
5. Land south of original 1.0 ha plot (0.80 ha)
to be secured before any further design.
6. Read with structural, civil, M&E and
Pavements, stormwater, water, sewer, power, lighting, CCTV, fire
Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
63 HDPE water + 2×110 HDPE ducts in spine
750 × 600 grated channel → oil separator OS1 (west), 900 Ø attenuation pipe along north kerb
Stormwater: 600 mm concrete dish channel / pipe
LV power — 2 × 110 HDPE ducts + draw pits
CCTV camera (PTZ on masts, fixed on poles)
F = 9 kg DCP extinguisher cabinet on post
80 mm S-block ICBP (35 MPa), herringbone 45°, on 25 mm sand, 150 mm C3, 150 mm G5
220 mm C35 jointed concrete, dowelled, on 150 mm C3
DESIGN DEMANDS (preliminary — M&E / civil to confirm)
Bypass separator, Class 1 (EN 858), full treatment 65 l/s; DG bays to dedicated sump
120 users × 60 L + 12 staff × 45 L + kiosk/laundry 2 kL ≈ 10 kL/day; storage 20 kL (2 days)
Required yield ≥ 1.2 m³/h over 10 h; WARMA permit; pump 1.1 kW submersible
Septic tank BS 6297: C = 180P + 2 000 = 180 × 132 + 2 000 ≈ 26 kL; soakaway by percolation test
Max. demand ≈ 65 kVA (lighting 13 kW, building 25 kVA, water heating 8 kW, pumps/gates 6 kW, kiosk/laundry 13 kW)
ZESCO 100 kVA pole-mount, 400/230 V 3-ph; 60 kVA standby genset + 22 kWp PV / 30 kWh battery
Yard avg 20 lx, U0 ≥ 0.25 (EN 12464-2, heavy-vehicle parking); 3 × 20 m masts + 16 × 12 m poles
Ng 8–12 flashes/km²/yr: masts earthed (10 Ω), SPDs Type 1+2 at main LV board (BS EN 62305)
1. Levels and outfall are indicative pending topographic survey; outfall to natural drainage subject to Council / ZEMA consent. Attenuation to limit discharge to pre-development rate if required.
2. All chambers and channel gratings in trafficked areas: Class D400 (EN 124).
3. Borehole ≥ 30 m from septic tank and soakaway (achieved ≈ 70 m).
4. Water main runs in the raised spine to protect it from wheel loads; standpipes SP1–SP3 for drivers.
5. CCTV head-end and ANPR at gate recorded in office/control room (07); 30-day retention.
